summary.result: As a result, the system was verified to have a sufficient outflow velocity for the removal of soil sediments.
summary.background: Coastal and fishing facilities are gradually deteriorating in function due to the continual accumulation of soil sediments, which has affected local economic activities.
summary.method: To solve these problems, this study proposed a non-power soil cleaning system and evaluated field applicability by carrying out field model tests.
